reviewContext.scope: earn/gig settle tx-bridge — round-5 re-review of the round-4 FAIL fixes (settle-write.mjs + settle-tx.mjs, FIND-001..004)
reviewContext.note: No manifest.json exists for this feature under .vcsdd (Glob confirmed); review conducted disk-only per the adversary mandate. The Bash tool was NOT available in this context, so `node --test` was NOT executed — every verdict is from static reading of the on-disk code+tests, and each round-4 claimed fix was checked against the actual code, not the commit message. Round numbering: prompt 'round-5'; written as the next on-disk impl iteration (iteration-4).

evidence.description: Loop spawns the slot with stdio ['ignore','pipe','pipe'] — stdin physically ignored; the slot cannot block on a human.
settle-write contains no stdin/readline/prompt; resolves the tx from a chain log or the test seam, never a human.
settle-tx is a pure RPC fetcher (eth_getBlockByNumber/eth_getLogs); no interactive input, fully autonomous.
do_settle resolves 'did I earn?' via record-earn's on-chain scan + an automated chain log lookup; no human step.
earn is parsed ONLY from record-earn's 'VERIFIED +X USDC' line (sed); settle-write.mjs is invoked ONLY inside the `[ "$earn" != "0" ]` branch. The slot cannot originate an amount.
earn=Number(argv); if !(earn>0) writes a zero line and exits; line.earn_usdc/net_usdc are exactly the record-earn amount — no fabrication path. SUPREME amount-integrity holds.

tx is injectable ONLY when process.env.FOUNDER_TEST==='1' && GIG_SETTLE_TX; in prod (FOUNDER_TEST unset) the seam is closed and tx MUST come from a real on-chain Transfer log via representativeExternalTx. GIG_SETTLE_TX is NOT parsed from the model's ANICCA_ARGS (run.sh:20-36), so the model cannot supply it.
Asserts prod IGNORES GIG_SETTLE_TX without FOUNDER_TEST (unreachable RPC => no_tx) and the line does NOT classify profitable — FIND-001(round-4) genuinely fixed and tested.

VERIFIED prints only when earned>0 from EXTERNAL inflows (from ∉ MY_WALLETS), finalized-head block cursor, logs re-verified (topic0==Transfer,address==USDC,padded to==founder), fail-closed; self-transfers sum to 0.

A profitable line requires tx && status==='0x1' && net>0 && external===true && not-swap. settle-write only sets tx+status when a real (or test-seam) tx exists; settle.test.mjs:23-33 confirms isProfitable(line)===true for the verified path.
wallet_address emits only an address-shaped field (0x, len<=44); a 66-char key would be rejected by the length filter.
settle-tx reads only BASE_RPC_URL (a URL, not a key) and the public USDC/Transfer constants; it prints nothing — returns an object. No secret is read or echoed.
settle-write prints ONLY the structured ledger line (ts/wallet/source/task/earn/cost/net/external/wake[/tx/status/no_tx]); no env secret is interpolated.
Loop redacts private-key patterns from both the observation and the wake ledger line; contract.test.mjs:64-67,91 asserts the planted keys never appear in stdout/stderr incl. the settle path.

Mode is driven by $ANICCA_ARGS (the real loop channel, index.mjs:445), GIG_MODE only a manual fallback; always exits 0; unknown mode falls back to detect; settle bounded by `timeout 45` under SKILL_TIMEOUT_S.
do_settle emits exactly one structured JSON line on every branch (record-earn-missing :126, zero-earn :140, settle-write line :138, or the emit fallback :138) — one structured line, exit 0.
Drives settle via ANICCA_ARGS with no real inflow → earn_usdc===0, !external, record-earn invoked, no key leak. Non-tautological on the no-inflow path.
bid idempotent: shouldRecordBid(r) === (r.ok===true); a failed POST stays retryable (verified unchanged this round).

POSITIVE — recordEarnRange reads the last founder-ledger row's from_block/to_block (written by record-earn.mjs:128) inside try/catch → returns {} on any error → graceful finalized fallback, NOT a crash. Missing founder ledger degrades gracefully.

FAIL — both 'real path' tests use an unreachable RPC, so representativeExternalTx only reaches its null/catch branch; the positive log-parse + founder/SHARED-exclude + window logic (settle-tx.mjs:41-59, the substance of the round-4 FIND-002/003/004 fixes) has ZERO executable coverage. A regression would pass all tests silently (FIND-001).
